violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026

(Scrambled eggs) was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026

The door to the outside, located in the (dining room ), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026
The (floors ) in the (kitchen between counter and refrigerator ) area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026

Working containers of cinnamon and raisins are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2025
